messages.subject_clean: [GRASS-stats] [GRASS GIS PSC Elections 2024] Nomination of Linda Karlovska
messages.body_plain:
Dear members of the GRASS GIS community,

Linda Karlovska has accepted a nomination made by Markus Neteler.


===================================

I am honored to nominate Linda Karlovska (formerly Kladivova) for
election to the GRASS GIS Project Steering Committee (PSC). Linda is a
major contributor to the GRASS GIS project and is currently pursuing
her Ph.D. at the Czech Technical University in Prague. Her academic
background and commitment to open source geospatial technology make
her an excellent candidate.
Linda's involvement with the GRASS GIS project began during the Google
Summer of Code, which marked the beginning of her deep involvement
with the project. One of her most notable contributions has been the
redesign of the graphical user interface (GUI) for GRASS GIS,
particularly the startup workflow. Linda has been instrumental in
improving the user experience and making the software more accessible,
especially to first-time users. Her dedication to improving the user
experience was highlighted in her presentation at FOSS4G 2021 entitled
"I hated the way GRASS started so I changed it", which resonated with
the community. So she worked on the new GUI startup for GRASS GIS 8,
addressing usability issues that had long been a challenge. In 2024,
she was awarded a GRASS GIS Student Grant, further recognizing her
contributions and continued involvement.
Linda's technical skills, creativity, and commitment to improving
GRASS GIS make her an excellent candidate for the PSC.


-- 
Hern?n De Angelis

Chief Return Officer (CRO)

messages.subject: [GRASS-stats] Maintainer for rgrass needed by end 2024
messages.subject_clean: [GRASS-stats] Maintainer for rgrass needed by end 2024
messages.body_plain:
In connection with the transfer of the grass-dev list to Discourse, which I am not prepared to follow as it will absorb much more time than scanning the digested list headers, I will give up maintaining the R-GRASS interface package at the end of 2024. 

The package lives in https://github.com/rsbivand/rgrass and the repo can be moved to the preferred location of the new maintainer, and the maintainer change notified to CRAN without difficulty. 

The arrival of Discourse precipitates a change that was started before a workshop at FOSS4G in 2022 https://rsbivand.github.io/foss4g_2022/modernizing_220822.html, and several GRASS users/developers then contributed to the workshop, and have helped improve the package over many years.

Before a hand-over, this group of contributors can go through issues not yet formally closed but mostly settled, to make sure that the new maintainer ramps up smoothly. 

Best wishes,

Roger

--
Roger Bivand
Emeritus Professor
Norwegian School of Economics
Postboks 3490 Ytre Sandviken, 5045 Bergen, Norway
Roger.Bivand at nhh.no

messages.subject_clean: [GRASS-stats] [GRASS GIS PSC Elections 2024] Reminder: the nomination period ends on Monday, October 7 12:00 UT
messages.body_plain:
Dear members of the GRASS GIS community,

Just a reminder that the nomination period for the GRASS GIS PSC 
Elections 2024 ends on monday, October 7 at 12:00 UT.

If you had thought of nominating someone but have not done so yet, now 
is the time to do it.


We welcome nominations for candidates to four seats of the Project 
Steering Committee (PSC) that are up for renewal this time. The period 
ends in three weeks, on October 7th (2024-10-07).

During the Nomination period, any member of the GRASS GIS community, can 
nominate any community member for being a candidate for the PSC.

Current PSC members can be nominated for re-election in the same way by 
the community as possible new candidates.

To set a nomination in motion, an e-mail should be directed to the Chief 
Return Officer (CRO - cro.grass at osgeo.org) including name, contact 
e-mail and, shortly, why a person is recommended as a PSC member.

The CRO will then contact the recommended person asking for confirmation.

The nominated person has to accept the candidacy and will be asked to 
write a few lines stating what she/he wants to achieve as part of it.

A nomination and its acceptance are required to be sent directly to the 
CRO in private. Following confirmation, it is CRO's task to officially 
announce a nomination.




Remember, these are the mportant dates for the 2024 elections:
- nomination period: 2024-09-16 to 2024-10-07
- presentation of the candidates: 2024-10-07 to 2024-10-14
- elections: 2024-10-21 to 2024-10-28
- announcement of the newly elected PSC: 2024-11-02 at latest


The whole election process is explained in full detail in the election 
Wiki (https://grasswiki.osgeo.org/wiki/PSC_Election_2024).




Hern?n De Angelis

Chief Return Officer (CRO)
GRASS GIS election 2024

messages.body_plain:
Hi Steven,

Thanks for responding! Could I suggest following up at https://github.com/rsbivand/rgrass/issues/96 ? This also of course is open to any others interested or concerned. rgrass and Rsagacmd overlap a little, but usage of rgrass has the possibility to spin up a temporary location (now project?), and to run GRASS commands constructed through the --interface-description argument, which has now been migrated from XML to xml2. rgrass has also not been roxygenised, as it began well before such tools. All these are things that can be cleared up, probably with the help of others pinged in the github issue I just raised, and others wishing to contribute.

Best wishes,

Roger

--
Roger Bivand
Emeritus Professor
Norwegian School of Economics
Postboks 3490 Ytre Sandviken, 5045 Bergen, Norway

work for as part of the PSC.

Dear members of the GRASS GIS community,

The period for the presentation of the candidates has ended. All 
candidates have now presented their statements of what they intend to do 
if they are elected as members of the PSC.

We now enter a period of no-action that will last for a week until 
2024-10-21 at 12:00 UT, when the voting will start. During this period, 
you are encouraged to read the candidates' statements, reflect about 
their content, and decide which candidates you may want to support with 
your vote.

Links to the statements can be found on the nomination table in the PSC 
Wiki:
https://grasswiki.osgeo.org/wiki/PSC_Election_2024

Dear members of the GRASS GIS community,

The voting period for four members of the Project Steering Committee 
(PSC) starts tomorrow, Monday 21 October, at 12:00 UT. The period runs 
for a full week and ends on Monday 28 October at 12:00 UT.

Those of you who are registered voters will soon receive an e-mail with 
a link to a survey in the OSGeo LimeSurvey voting system. The system is 
set to be enabled at 12:00 UT on 21 October and closed at 12:00 UT on 28 
October. Voting is not possible outside this period.

I hope you had time to reflect on which candidates you want to support 
with your vote. In any case, note that a link to the each of the 
statements can be found on the nomination table in the PSC Wiki:
https://grasswiki.osgeo.org/wiki/PSC_Election_2024
